about_the_game:
The Depths Pack takes you to the dark side with the Creature, Purple Eater, Bones, and X-Ray skins. Step out from the shadows and command the arena with these eerie and mysterious skins!

Get ready to squad up, suit up, and explore the depths as you take down your foes with precision. Tidal Shock is free to play—never pay to win! So, every skin you wear shows off your commitment to dominating the arena and supporting indie innovation.

Support the Little Guys: Your purchase keeps our indie team swimming, and with your help, we’ll continue creating unforgettable experiences!
